source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The added browser scenario clicks row content through firstElementChild, registers its select promise before the click, and waits for select delivery. It then checks the active index, selected-class row and visible-row order while a preceding branch collapses and expands. Multi-select mode is enabled, but the scenario expects one selected row at each step. The event promise does not establish completion of all listeners, rendering or every multi-row selection path.
title: The tree collapse scenario checks row identity after visible indices shift
